overall_assessment: The release workflow and distribution pipeline strictly enforce supply-chain hardening invariants: 100% full 40-character commit-SHA pinning for all external GitHub Actions, explicit top-level and job-level minimal permissions, secrets leak scanning, CycloneDX SBOM generation, SHA-256 hash manifests, and strict non-publishable crate controls keeping all 30 workspace crates private. Findings confirm no hardcoded secrets or unpinned dependencies exist.

findings.description: check_workflow_hardening.py validates that all external actions use 40-character hex commit SHAs rather than mutable tag references.
findings.recommendation: Maintain automated dependabot or equivalent commit SHA update checks in CI.

findings.description: CycloneDX SBOM generation scripts accurately index all source components and third-party dependency declarations with deterministic canonical JSON output.
findings.recommendation: Integrate binary dependency component graph once final release binaries are produced.

findings.description: release/public-packages.json strictly maintains an empty publishable array, preventing accidental cargo publish or registry exposure.
findings.recommendation: Retain this firewall until explicit semver, security, and licence promotion criteria are fulfilled.

calibration_notes: Security auditors confirm that supply-chain invariants, credential hygiene, and provenance controls meet rigorous standards for alpha release preparation.
